summary: Structural wall sections, design criteria, material notes, special-inspection notes, and light-gage framing notes are shown. Preliminary concerns are primarily document-control and citation-coordination items; no specific structural capacity discrepancy can be established from this sheet alone.

drafts.title: Revision status is not reconciled with the revision table
drafts.observation: The sheet footer states “REVISED PERMIT SET 10/15/2026,” while the visible REVISIONS table in the upper-right title-block area contains no revision number, description, or date entries.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Blank REVISIONS table at the upper-right title block; footer at the bottom right reads “REVISED PERMIT SET 10/15/2026.”
drafts.drawing_location: Upper-right title block and bottom sheet border
drafts.recommendation: Enter the applicable revision number, description, and date in the revision table, or otherwise coordinate the title-block revision record with the stated revised permit-set date.

drafts.title: Sheet-count field appears incomplete
drafts.observation: The title block shows the sheet field as “OF 00,” which does not identify the total sheet count.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Title block fields at lower right show “SHEET: OF 00”; the printed sheet number is S-201.00.
drafts.recommendation: Verify and correct the sheet-count field before permit issuance so the sheet can be reliably tracked within the permit set.

drafts.title: Special-inspection section mapping should be verified
drafts.observation: The sheet states that a special-inspection statement is required where applicable under “sections 109.3.13 and 1705,” while the adjacent cloud lists specific inspection categories and section numbers, including “CONCRETE CONSTRUCTION 1705.3,” “MASONRY CONSTRUCTION 1705.4,” and “COLD-FORMED STEEL 1705.3.4.” The applicable section assignments should be confirmed against the adopted DC code text.
drafts.drawing_evidence: “SPECIAL INSPECTIONS (STRUCTURAL)” note and adjacent cloud listing inspection categories and cited sections 1705.3, 1705.4, and 1705.3.4.
drafts.suggested_code_reference: 2015 IBC base code, Sections 109.3.13 and 1705, as cited on the drawing
drafts.recommendation: Have the structural design professional and code consultant verify the section references and inspection-category mapping against the adopted 2017 District of Columbia Construction Codes, then revise the note if necessary.

drafts.title: Wood-design cross-reference is ambiguous
drafts.observation: Wood Notes item 7 directs the reader to “section 23 of IBC 2015,” but does not identify whether this is intended to mean a chapter, section, or another referenced standard.
drafts.drawing_evidence: Wood Notes item 7 reads: “REFER TO SECTION 23 OF IBC 2015 FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.”
drafts.drawing_location: Structural notes panel, WOOD NOTES, item 7
drafts.suggested_code_reference: 2015 IBC base code, Chapter 23, as apparently intended by the drawing note
drafts.recommendation: Confirm the intended IBC reference and revise the note to identify the correct chapter or section explicitly.
